validation_evidence.source_scope_note: CR000140 records PECANN Helmholtz forward and hydraulic inverse notebook cases at the retained Stage-2 SHA. Three configurations preserve forward, high-fidelity and multi-fidelity settings, including squared-constraint penalties, inactive scheduling and reused inverse trial state. Incomplete environment/install instructions limit reproducibility to R1.
